chapter.verse: Mual siangtho tungah ama phuhsa khuapi om hi.
Topa in Jakob’ teen’na mun khempeuhte sangin Zion kulh kongpi itzaw hi.
Pasian’ khuapi aw, nangma minthan’na teng hong kigen hi.
Kei hong theite lakah Izipt leh Babilon ka hel hi; Filistia, Tai-ar leh Ethiopia-te zong—“Hihte pen hua lai mah pan-a piang ahi hi,” amaute in ci ding uh hi.
Zion thu tawh kisai-in ahih leh, “Minam khempeuh ama sung pan-a suak ahi hi,” kici ding hi; Bang hang hiam cih leh Sang Penpa mahmah in amah kipsak ding hi.
Topa in, “Hihte pen hua lai-a suak” ci-in minam khempeuh ciamtehin gelh ding hi.
Tua sung a teeng mi khempeuh in a kibangin, “Ka lungdamna bulpite khempeuh uh nangma sungah om hi,” ci ding uh hi.
